**Do not report security vulnerabilities here — use private vulnerability reporting: https://github.com/tanshuai/alphabiz/security/advisories/new**

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what goes wrong.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open '...'
2. Click '...'
3. ...

**Expected behaviour**
What you expected to happen.

**Actual behaviour**
What happens instead. Include the exact error text if there is one.

**Environment**
- OS and version: [e.g. Windows 11 23H2, macOS 14.5, Ubuntu 22.04]
- CPU architecture: [x64 / arm64]
- Alphabiz version and channel: [as shown in the app's title bar / version label, e.g. 0.3.3 stable]
- Install source: [alpha.biz download / GitHub release file / AUR / .deb / .snap / own build from this repository / web edition at web.alpha.biz]

**Logs or screenshots**
Paste the relevant log excerpt or attach screenshots.

**Web edition only (optional)**
- Browser and version: [e.g. Chrome 128, Firefox 129, Safari 17]
